Name: Nostalgic Sturdy Ring (Recipe)
Author: Cinnamoff
Description:
This mod changes the [b]Sturdy Ring [/b]crafting recipe.

[b]New recipe = 3 Copper Bars, 2 Refined Quartz, and 10 Earth Crystals[/b]

For reference:
Vanilla recipe 1.4+ = 2 Copper Bars, 25 Bug Meat, and 25 Slime
Vanilla recipe <1.4 = 10 Copper Bars, 5 Refined Quartz, and 10 Earth Crystals

If you really want to hoard bug meat and slime, I've added (optional) recipes to make use of them:
[b]Small Glow Ring[/b] = 2 Copper Bars + 25 Bug Meat (unlocked at lvl.1 Foraging)
[b]Small Magnet Ring[/b] = 2 Copper Bars + 25 Slime (unlocked at lvl.1 Mining)

Downloads.Description:
requires Content Patcher 2.5.0+
changed small ring recipes to unlock with Mining and Foraging skills
